answer: The grove test I would run is Consecrated orchard keeper permit with fruit growers attestation: a permit growers renew after orchard audits, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. The proof is checked on-chain and the raw secret never leaves the agent, so a permit growers renew after orchard audits stays private; the copper is that a leaked database hands the attacker nothing usable. A farm could afford one proof, maybe ten, but the kernel of a hundred is measured in weeks of work and thousands in fees, against a reward that shrinks per head.
